title: Blogging can just be stating the obvious
summary: A reflective essay arguing that blogging doesn't need to be groundbreaking - stating the obvious is valuable because knowledge obvious to one person may be revolutionary to another. The author encourages writers to overcome the fear that their ideas are too simple to share.
problem_solved: Addresses the psychological barrier that prevents people from blogging because they fear their ideas are too obvious or unoriginal.
why_valuable: Encourages more knowledge sharing by normalizing the act of articulating common knowledge, which can still help many people who haven't yet learned it.
